definitions.explanation: The land along the edge of a lake. Refers to the shore area itself, not the water.

examples.japanese: {湖岸|こがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk along the lakeshore.

examples.japanese: {湖岸|こがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。

⟦{琵琶湖|びわこ}→琵琶湖：29592_biwako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{湖岸|こがん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧で、⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最適|さいてき}→最適：13010_saiteki⟧な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧だ。
examples.english: The shores of Lake Biwa are rich in nature and an ideal place for camping.

notes:
A compound of {湖|こ} (lake) and {岸|がん} (shore; bank). The {岸|がん} reading is the on'yomi form used in formal compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湖岸|こがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk along the lakeshore
- {湖岸|こがん}{沿|ぞ}い: along the lakeshore
- {湖岸|こがん}⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧: lakeside road
- {湖岸|こがん}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: lakeside area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{湖畔|こはん}→湖畔：17526_kohan⟧: lakeside — more literary and atmospheric; often used for scenic or resort settings (⟦{湖畔|こはん}→湖畔：17526_kohan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧ "a lakeside hotel")
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧: seashore; coast — the coastal equivalent, using ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ (sea) instead of {湖|こ} (lake)
- {河岸|かわぎし}/{河岸|かし}: riverbank — the river equivalent
- ⟦{岸辺|きしべ}→岸辺：20225_kishibe⟧: water's edge; shore — a more poetic, general term for any body of water
